title: capture reuse misses when the reviewer retypes an equivalent command (trailing ' .'), re-running the full suite
detail: same-phase-capture-reuse: solo_execute captured '../../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q' green (4564) at tree 595f6f95666258f4, exec_dir worktrees/solo. regression-sentinel captured '../../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q .' (it appended ' .' on its own; its spec gives no exact command) at the same tree and exec dir; reuse keys on byte-exact command text, so it re-ran the suite (478s, identical result). Class: reuse depends on an agent retyping a command exactly. The sentinel should be handed or able to look up the recorded command (e.g. capture names the reusable command, or the spec / dispatch tells the sentinel to copy the command from solo_execute.evidence.json) rather than relying on retyping; normalising arbitrary commands is unsafe.
